description: This is a source HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface. It contains the structure, styles, and embedded JavaScript code for rendering and interacting with a database browsing UI, including fetching database information, tables, and data, and displaying them dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays the data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with fetched data.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
